title: Concessional Duty Framework for Industrial Raw Materials
summary: This thread tracks the evolution of fiscal incentives (duty exemptions/reductions) for industrial raw materials. It shifts from broad exemptions for specific sectors to structured, HS-code-based regulatory frameworks that integrate VAT compliance and specific manufacturing requirements.

evolution.legal_basis: Shifted from Customs Act 1969 to Customs Act 2023 and integrated with VAT Act 2012.
evolution.structure: Evolved from general exemptions to a multi-table, HS-code-specific classification system.
evolution.eligibility: Increased focus on VAT-compliant manufacturing and specific industrial sectors.

timeline.change: Introduction of specific duty reduction mechanism for industrial inputs based on HS codes.
Expansion of the duty concession framework into multiple tables (1-6) for different industrial categories.
Formal alignment with the VAT and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012 for industrial raw material concessions.
Transition to the Customs Act, 2023 framework for managing industrial raw material duty concessions.

Customs Act 1969: This statutory order is issued under Section 19(1) of the Customs Act 1969.
The Act governs the enforcement of penalties, including the recovery of duties and taxes, and provides the regulatory framework for customs operations and duty exemptions.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: This instrument is issued under the authority of Section 14(1) of the Value Added Tax Act 1991, enabling the government to grant specific tax exemptions.
First Schedule: The goods covered by this exemption notification are classified under the First Schedule of the Customs Act 1969.
National Board of Revenue: The government, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, issued this order to provide duty and tax exemptions on specific raw materials for the handloom industry.
H.S. Code: The order specifies distinct H.S. Codes for chemicals, dyes, and yarns that are eligible for duty and tax concessions when imported for the handloom industry.
TABLE: The table lists the eligible Heading and H.S. Code categories for industrial raw materials that qualify for duty and tax relief.
Imported Raw Materials: The specified raw materials are granted exemptions from import duty, regulatory duty, value-added tax, and supplementary duty, provided the import value duty exceeds the stated threshold.
These materials must be imported exclusively for use in the handloom industry by societies registered with the Bangladesh Handloom Board.
Bangladesh Handloom Board: The Bangladesh Handloom Board is responsible for registering handloom societies, determining import quotas for member societies, and notifying customs authorities about authorized imports.
They are also required to monitor the distribution of imported goods and provide necessary documentation to the local VAT authorities to ensure compliance.
Commissioner of Customs: Importers must submit a formal undertaking on non-judicial stamp paper to the relevant Commissioner of Customs declaring the intended use of the imported materials.
The Commissioner is empowered to collect duties, taxes, and fines if audit reports reveal that the goods were not utilized for their authorized purpose.

শর্তাবলি
(১) সংশ্লিষ্ট আমদানিকারককে Industrial IRC holder VAT compliant উৎপাদনকারী শিল্প (Manufacturing industry) হইতে হইবে;
ব্যাখ্যা:
(অ) Industrial IRC holder অর্থ এইরূপ প্রতিষ্ঠান যাহার নিকট আমদানি ও রপ্তানি প্রধান নিয়ন্ত্রকের দপ্তর হইতে ইস্যুকৃত হালনাগাদ শিল্প ভোক্তা (Industrial Consumer) আইআরসি রহিয়াছে;
(আ) VAT compliant অর্থ মূল্য সংযোজন কর ও সম্পূরক শুল্ক আইন, ২০১২ ও মূল্য সংযোজন কর ও সম্পূরক শুল্ক বিধিমালা, ২০১৬ এর অধীন নিবন্ধিত নিয়মিত দাখিলপত্র (রিটার্ন) দাখিল করে এইরূপ উৎপাদনকারী প্রতিষ্ঠান;
(২) এই প্রজ্ঞাপনের আওতায় পণ্য আমদানি ও খালাসের লক্ষ্যে প্রতিষ্ঠানটির হালনাগাদ নবায়নকৃত শিল্প ভোক্তা আইআরসি রহিয়াছে এবং ১৩ ডিজিট সংবলিত মূল্য সংযোজন কর (মূসক) নিবন্ধিত প্রতিষ্ঠানটি বিবেচ্য বিল অব এন্ট্রি দাখিলের অব্যবহিত পূর্ববর্তী মাসের মূসক দাখিলপত্র (রিটার্ন) দাখিল করিয়াছে মর্মে কাস্টমস কম্পিউটার সিস্টেমে বা ভ্যাট অনলাইন সিস্টেমে বা জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড এর ওয়েবসাইটে বা ভ্যাট কমিশনারেট এর ওয়েবসাইটে ইলেকট্রনিক তথ্য প্রদর্শিত থাকিতে হইবে:
তবে শর্ত থাকে যে, কোনো দৈব-দুর্বিপাক বা কোনো যৌক্তিক কারণে ইলেকট্রনিক তথ্য পাওয়া সম্ভব না হইলে সংশ্লিষ্ট কমিশনার অব কাস্টমস প্রতি ক্ষেত্রে কারণ লিপিবদ্ধ করিয়া শুল্কায়নের প্রয়োজনীয় কার্যক্রম গ্রহণ করিতে পারিবে।

Customs Act 2023: This SRO is issued under the authority granted by Section 25(1) of the Customs Act 2023.
The Act provides the legal basis for granting exemptions on customs duties and regulatory duties for specific industrial raw materials.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: This SRO is issued under the authority granted by Section 126(1) of the Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act 2012.
The Act defines the VAT compliance requirements that industries must meet to qualify for duty exemptions.
National Board of Revenue: The Board is the regulatory body consulted for the issuance of this SRO and the establishment of its duty exemption framework.
Industrial IRC Holder: An Industrial IRC holder is defined as an entity possessing a valid Industrial Consumer IRC issued by the Office of the Chief Controller of Imports and Exports.
Only manufacturers holding this status are eligible for the specific customs duty, supplementary duty, and regulatory duty exemptions listed in the order.
VAT Compliant: An entity is considered VAT compliant if it is registered under the Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act 2012 and the associated Rules, and regularly submits its VAT returns.
Compliance status must be verifiable through the customs or VAT online systems to benefit from the tax exemptions provided in this order.
H.S. Code: The SRO specifies various H.S. Codes in its six tables, identifying the raw materials eligible for duty concessions when imported by qualifying industries.
The applicable duty rates for imports are determined based on the specific H.S. Code and the corresponding industrial category.
